requested_time.description: 2024-25 Institutional Characteristics release; the source asks about undergraduates enrolled in Fall 2023 (student observation year: Fall 2023)

assumptions: The percentage is the institution-reported share of all undergraduates (full- or part-time) enrolled in Fall 2023 who are formally registered with the disability services office, as reported in the 2024-25 IC release; student observation year is Fall 2023.

DISABPCT is populated only when the share is more than 3 percent. The DISAB indicator (1 = 3 percent or less, 2 = more than 3 percent, -1 not reported, -2 not applicable) is shown alongside, so an exact percentage may not exist if the share is 3 percent or less.
IC2024 is keyed by UNITID only, so no additional row selectors are required.

definition_evidence.title: Percent indicator of undergraduates formally registered as students with disabilities
definition_evidence.long_description: Please indicate the percentage of all undergraduates enrolled in Fall 2023 who are formally registered as students with disabilities with the institution's office of disability services (or the equivalent office): This variable applies only to undergraduate students enrolled either full- or part-time. If fewer than 3% of the institution’s undergraduate students are registered with the disability services (or equivalent) office, the actual percent is not indicated. However, if more than 3% of the institution’s undergraduate students are registered with the disability services (or equivalent) office, the appropriate percentage is given. See variable DISABPCT.
